subtitle: Embed a fake answer instead of the real question — on purpose

steps.label: HYDE MATCHES
steps.sub: Answer style, even if facts are wrong

code:
{
  "model": "claude-opus-5-5", "max_tokens": 300,
  "system": "Write a short, plausible paragraph\n"
            "answering the question. Don't hedge.",
  "messages": [{ "role": "user",
    "content": "What is the cancellation policy?" }]
}
caption: The paragraph is never shown to the user — only its embedding is used.
